d: Did you know almost half of urban India's land is wasted not by accident, but by a rule almost nobody talks about? New York gives 45% of its land to streets and parks; Mumbai gives barely 15%. The difference isn't money, it's a building regulation that forces every structure to sit marooned in empty margins, turning more than half our cities into useless strips of weeds and rubble.
